correctness.rationale: For H_n (edges a_i b_j iff i≤j), n≥4, write x_i=f(a_i), y_i=f(b_i) and s_i=x_i+y_i−1≥0 by zero-independence on each matched edge. The left leaf and its successor enforce s1+s2≥2; reflected right endpoint enforces s(n−1)+s_n≥2, giving total weight≥n+4. Equality eliminates one-surplus leaf exceptions, forces each interior pair to be (1,0) or (0,1), and Ferrers zero-independence gives one threshold t. Two legal endpoint pairs on each side yield exactly 4(n−1) optimizers. An independent direct definition-level 4^(2n) enumeration checked all assignments of weight≤n+4 on H4 and H5 (1,114,112 candidates before weight pruning), recovering 12 and 16 and no other minima. n2,n3 excluded from classification.
